eventName.description: Event name this workflow subscribes to. MUST match the `events.md` §Types grammar: two or three dot-separated kebab-case segments, never `openwop.`-prefixed (that prefix is reserved for the protocol). A `{{params.<name>}}` placeholder is also accepted and is the CORRECT form for a reusable chain — the event belongs to the installing host, not to the pack. The previous pattern `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$` admitted any number of segments and underscores, which is how `host.forms.submission.created` and `workflow.approval_needed` were published: names no conformant host may emit, on a trigger that then silently never fires.

source.description: Optional source filter. When set, only events from this source trigger the workflow. Sources are host-defined (e.g., `'crm'`, `'billing'`, vendor names).
